name: 2CRSI S.a.
summary: Headquartered in Strasbourg, France, and established in 2005, 2CRSI S.A. operates as a global entity specializing in the creation, production, and distribution of advanced computing solutions. Their product line features a variety of hardware, including rackmount servers, Open Compute Project (OCP) servers and racks, and high-performance workstations. Beyond these core products, 2CRSI offers sophisticated cooling technologies such as air, direct liquid, and immersion systems, alongside specialized solutions in data science, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, gaming, and edge computing. The company also provides professional, hosted, and High-Performance Computing (HPC) managed services. 2CRSI serves diverse markets and applications, including cloud computing environments, data centers, enterprise IT, big data analytics, HPC, AI, 5G infrastructure, IoT, ruggedized PCs, embedded systems, and edge computing deployments. Furthermore, their offerings encompass hardware supply, datacenter colocation, and hosting services.
